'''Willem Rutger van Zwet''' (31 March 1934 – 2 July 2020) was a Dutch mathematical statistician.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.isi-web.org/index.php/news/20196-in-memoriam-willem-van-zwet|title=In Memoriarium: William van Zwet|date=2 July 2020|work=International Statistical Institute|access-date=8 July 2020|archive-date=7 July 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200707033626/https://www.isi-web.org/index.php/news/20196-in-memoriam-willem-van-zwet|url-status=dead}}</ref> He was a professor at [[Leiden University]] between 1968 and 1999.

== Education and career ==
Van Zwet was born on 31 March 1934 in [[Leiden]].<ref name=leiden>{{cite web|author= |url=https://hoogleraren.leidenuniv.nl/id/2870 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200709221601/https://hoogleraren.leidenuniv.nl/id/2870 |title=Willem Rutger van Zwet |publisher=Leiden University |date= |archive-date=9 July 2020}}</ref> Van Zwet obtained his doctoral degree in 1964 under the supervision of [[Jan Hemelrijk]] at the [[University of Amsterdam]] with a thesis titled "Convex Transformations of Random Variables".<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu/id.php?id=68841|title=Willem Rutger van Zwet|work=North Dakota State University}}</ref> After that, he worked at the [[Centrum Wiskunde & Informatica]] in [[Amsterdam]], and became a lector of statistics at [[Leiden University]] in 1964 and was named professor in 1968. He retired in 1999.<ref name=leiden/>

From 1992 to 1999, Van Zwet was the Director of the Thomas Stieltjes Institute of Mathematics. He co-founded Eurandom in 1997, and served as its director until 2000. From 1997 to 1999, he was also the President of the [[International Statistical Institute]].

== Honors and awards ==
Van Zwet was a Fellow of the [[Institute of Mathematical Statistics]] and a member of the [[Academia Europaea]] since 1990.<ref>{{cite web|author= |url=https://www.ae-info.org/ae/Member/van_Zwet_Willem |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190328165247/https://www.ae-info.org/ae/Member/van_Zwet_Willem |title=Willem van Zwet |publisher=Academia Europaea |date= |archive-date=28 March 2019}}</ref> He received the [[Humboldt Prize]] in 2006. He won the [[Adolphe Quetelet]] Medal in 1993, and had been a Fellow of the [[Royal Statistical Society]] since 1978. In 1979, he became a member of the [[Royal Netherlands Academy of Arts and Sciences]].<ref>{{cite web|author= |url=https://knawgenootschap.nl/leden/van-zwet-w-r/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200708180813/https://knawgenootschap.nl/leden/van-zwet-w-r/ |title=Prof. dr. w.r. Willem van Zwet |language=Dutch |publisher=KNAW genootschap |date= |archive-date=8 July 2020}}</ref> In 1996, he was made Knight of the [[Order of the Netherlands Lion]], and was named Doctoris Honoris causa of [[Charles University]] the following year. He died on 2 July 2020 in [[Oegstgeest]].<ref name=leiden/>
